title: Load Balancing with HAProxy — Companion Code
title_es: Balanceo de carga con HAProxy — Código complementario
description: Runnable simulations of HAProxy's health-check state machine in Python, JavaScript and Java: fall/rise probe gating that removes a flapping backend and a leastconn dispatcher that steers traffic to a recovered server, accompanying the HAProxy load balancing recipe.
description_es: Simulaciones ejecutables de la máquina de estados de health checks de HAProxy en Python, JavaScript y Java: el control fall/rise que retira un backend inestable y un dispatcher leastconn que dirige tráfico al servidor recuperado, que acompañan a la receta de balanceo con HAProxy.
